headline: The warehouse floor now glows with traffic
lede: FLOOR BOSS learned to show its exertion: every aisle cell burns orange in proportion to how many robots are routed through it, and a cell where two routes meet pulses hot — the jam the law will freeze is visible a beat before it happens.

notes.text: Live traffic heat shipped (#2680/#2682): flowHeat counts each bot's route per cell, pure and hash-invisible; the painter lays cyan legality, orange exertion, amber law — in that order, and nothing about the sim's rules moved.

Proof ran deep: 12 new gates (route sums, dedup, a full-shift display contract, purity), a mutant kill, and a headless-Chrome leg that watches real auto-dispatch traffic converge and glows warm pixels where routes cross.

PLAICRAFT S1 (#1711) still ends on one hardware line: a phone clap take from Jon — jonq #2652 answers by Nov 20 or the default keeps the nightly grader waiting. Everything else on the stage is proven.
Harness catch: idle-kick flips its pick when the GitHub API flakes silently — score the never-dry ladder from a retried issues snapshot before filing, and confirm the pick twice.
